description: Source code implementing RFC 1521 base64 encoding and decoding functions for Zephyr OS, including maps and functions for encoding and decoding buffers.

methods.name: base64_encode
methods.description: Encodes a buffer into base64 format, handling padding and output length.

methods.name: base64_decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 formatted buffer back into binary data, validating input and handling whitespace.
